boards.title: Your First Weekend at SUNY Oneonta, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A documented, under-21-safe campus sequence: orient yourself, find social and study spaces, then sample outdoor, arts and evening options.

cards.title: Start at Hunt Union
cards.subtitle: Campus hub · first floor information desk
cards.notes: Use the information desk to get oriented, then scan the building’s posted events and services before choosing your next stop.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a practical campus anchor and event check.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta’s campus map identifies Hunt Union and its information desk; the university lists building hours when classes are in session.
cards.source_title: Office of Student Life & Leadership at Hunt Union
cards.access_notes: When classes are in session, published weekend building hours are Saturday 9 a.m.–10 p.m. and Sunday 10 a.m.–9 p.m.; confirm exceptions before going.

cards.title: Settle in at the Dragon's Lair
cards.subtitle: Hunt Union · first-floor lobby
cards.notes: Bring a snack, choose a board or video game, or simply use the lounge as a low-pressure place to meet people.
cards.short_summary: A campus lounge built around social gaming and hanging out.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta describes the Dragon’s Lair as a free, student-focused lounge in the first-floor lobby of Hunt Union with board, card, retro and modern games.
cards.access_notes: Located directly left of the first-floor Hunt Union lobby entrance; availability follows building operations and programming.

cards.title: Pick up a campus essential
cards.subtitle: Red Dragon Outfitters · campus store
cards.notes: Browse for a notebook, dorm supply, workout item, or school gear, and ask staff where campus ID and dining services are located.
cards.short_summary: The campus store combines practical supplies with Oneonta gear.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta states that Red Dragon Outfitters carries school and dorm supplies, Oneonta fashions, workout gear, gifts and other items.
cards.access_notes: Published regular store hours are Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m. and Saturday 10 a.m.–4 p.m. when classes are in session.

cards.title: Find your Milne Library spot
cards.subtitle: Milne Library · five floors
cards.notes: Walk through the Social Zone, reading room, quiet study areas, and group rooms to find a work style that fits your weekend.
cards.short_summary: A library stop that doubles as a study-space orientation.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta describes Milne Library as having five floors, a first-floor Social Zone, quiet study areas, workstations and group meeting rooms.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current hours of operation before visiting; the university notes public entry and visitor-parking guidance.

cards.title: See what is on view
cards.subtitle: Fine Arts · gallery spaces
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition listing, then visit during open gallery hours for a focused break between campus errands.
cards.short_summary: Three campus galleries provide an arts-focused afternoon stop.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta operates three art galleries, publishes current and upcoming exhibitions, and lists free admission.
cards.access_notes: Published gallery hours are Tuesday–Saturday, 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; galleries close between exhibitions and operate by appointment during university recesses.

cards.title: Move at Alumni Field House
cards.subtitle: Student Life Center · fitness and wellness
cards.notes: Use the recreation schedule to choose a fitness or wellness session that matches your experience level and brings a little structure to the day.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation stop with fitness facilities and programming.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta says Fitness & Wellness facilities for students are in the Student Life Center at Chase Gym and the Alumni Field House.
cards.access_notes: Use the university recreation schedule for current facility and program availability; student ID cards provide access to the Fitness Center.

cards.title: Locate Red Dragon Field
cards.subtitle: Outdoor athletics complex
cards.notes: Walk past the field and adjacent athletics areas to orient yourself for future games, recreation, and campus wayfinding.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor landmark for learning the athletics side of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta identifies Red Dragon Field as an outdoor athletic facility for soccer, lacrosse and field hockey, and lists it on the campus map.
cards.access_notes: Treat the field as an outdoor orientation stop; event and field availability can change with athletics and recreation schedules.

cards.title: Take a College Camp trail walk
cards.subtitle: 119 Hoffman Road · 276 acres
cards.notes: Download the trail map, choose an appropriate route, and use the camp’s woodland setting for a daylight reset with friends.
cards.short_summary: A university community camp with former farmland and woodland.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta describes College Camp as a 276-acre former farm and woodland at 119 Hoffman Road for educational, recreational and social opportunities.
cards.access_notes: Use the official trail map and follow College Camp guidance; select a daylight outing suited to conditions and your group.

cards.title: Check the planetarium schedule
cards.subtitle: Perna Science Building · basement
cards.notes: Look for a scheduled live show, reserve tickets if offered, and make the planetarium your indoor science stop for the weekend.
cards.short_summary: A long-running campus planetarium with live dome shows.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta says its planetarium is in the basement of Perna Science Building, presents live shows, and offers ticket reservations.
cards.access_notes: Shows and ticket availability vary; use the university’s reservation link or contact the program before making the trip.

cards.title: End at Mills Marketplace
cards.subtitle: Mills Hall · evening food option
cards.notes: If you need food after evening activities, check the current dining page and use Mills Marketplace only during its posted service window.
cards.short_summary: A campus food stop with published regular late-night service.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta’s dining operator lists Mills Marketplace regular hours as 11 a.m.–1 a.m. daily, while also posting seasonal exceptions.
cards.access_notes: The published regular schedule is 11 a.m.–1 a.m. daily, but the same page posts seasonal closures and special hours; verify the current week before going.
